newsitem.title: USA: Metromail positioned for growth - chairman.
newsitem.headline: Metromail positioned for growth - chairman.

text.p: Metromail Corp is well positioned for continued growth in its three primary lines of business, chairman Barton Faber said Thursday at the company's first annual shareholders meeting.
The company helps clients to identify, reach and serve targeted audiences, specializing in direct marketing, database marketing and reference services.
Faber reiterated Metromail's annual financial goals, including 15 to 17 percent sales growth, 20 to 25 percent earnings and cash flow growth and operating margin expansion.
The company, previously part of R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co, had its initial public offering in June 1996. ((Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
